$comment: Canonical datasets the web app ETL produces and native apps consume. The web repo is the source of truth. Directory mappings may be consumer-specific; null means that app does not consume that path. Use web/scripts/sync-shared-data.mjs with --consumer ios|android and --root <checkout> to sync or --check to detect drift.

directories.note: Every Town Board meeting, its fiscal-impact companion, and the index/roster files. Mirrored wholesale because a new meeting must not require editing this manifest.

Annual Financial Report datasets used by Android.
